'''Quaagan''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] native of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Quaagan was a traitor to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], working for [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] shortly after the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]]. Quaagan attempted to help Ventress escape from the other Wookiees, but was killed when he was pushed off the roof of a tree-house.
